text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 19, 2024) for 40 Gerrard Street East

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 19, 2024) for 40 Gerrard Street East, Folder Number 24 215208 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to October 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
